images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A bright, punchy mobile-style comic puzzle game on a peach halftone-dot background with bold black ink outlines and chunky offset drop shadows. Left: a cream comic page with four black-and-white manga panels in a 2x2 grid — a rainy bus stop, a boy with spiky hair holding a closed umbrella, a girl with a bob and yellow hairpin, a dramatic speed-line close-up, the boy offering the umbrella, the girl under the umbrella while he runs into the rain. Hand-lettered speech bubbles in the panels, one dashed empty bubble slot glowing pink, and one bubble '먼저 갈게.' lifted and tilted mid-drag with a pointer hand and a dashed pink arrow. Small '⇄ 순서' swap buttons on each panel. Right side: a semicircular ending gauge with colored segments '엇갈림', '우정', '고백', '???' and a needle pointing at '엇갈림'; a dotted tray of spare speech bubbles; big chunky buttons, the pink one reading '이대로 완성!'. Top: logo '말풍선 퍼즐', pill '제 047화'. Clean vector manga style, CMY print palette of cyan, magenta and yellow.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Success moment in a bright comic puzzle game: the same four-panel manga page, but panels two and three are swapped and every panel has bloomed from grayscale into full color — cyan umbrella, navy school uniform, cream cardigan, blue rain streaks. The speech bubbles now tell a different story, including a jagged yellow shout bubble '금방 올게!'. A giant tilted yellow sticker stamp slams across the page reading '숨은 결말 발견!' and a huge white outlined word '고백' with magenta offset shadow, surrounded by radiating yellow and white burst rays and falling confetti outlined in black. Right side: three big yellow stars with the middle one raised, a dashed note explaining which panels were swapped, an ending collection grid of four cards with the new '고백' card glowing pink and one locked '?' card, and a large pink button '다음 화 ▸'. Clean vector manga style, peach halftone background, bold black ink lines, joyful high-energy mood. Consistency: the four panels are the exact same drawings as the grayscale page — the spiky-haired boy and the girl with a short bob and yellow hairpin at the rainy bus stop — only recolored, with panels 2 and 3 swapped; do not redraw the characters or change their hairstyles. The ending collection cards read exactly "엇갈림", "우정", "고백" (glowing) and a locked "???".
